review_evidence: The unit is the single 612-line blog/lean/PsychVerbs/PsychVerbSem.lean module; complete declaration scanning finds 33 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

Direct inspection shows a substantive cognitive-situation semantics for psych verbs: ExperiencerState, CausalPathway, psychVerbSem, compositional bridges, and checked consequences connecting opacity, causation, temporal behavior, and existing Linglib formalizations.

The long-form explanatory comments cite the linguistic literature and document how the formal definitions relate to the retained semantics/pragmatics modules, so the blog location does not make the file disposable.
summary: Retain the PsychVerbs blog formalization: it contains a substantial typed semantic model and 33 checked propositions, not blog-only scaffolding.
